Zoe: Afternoon handoff — quick summary before I step off (15:00 PT).
Zoe: Earlier today we saw a ~11:45–12:25 PT embedding p95 spike in eu-west leading to ~1,200 429s across 3 tenants. Root cause looks like autoscaler oscillation + a noisy internal batch reindex job hitting the same nodes.
oncall-bot: Incident alert: embeddings-euw p95 latency > 800ms — 429 rate increased. Pager triggered at 11:46 PT.
Zoe: Immediate mitigations applied: 1) manually scaled embedding pool +2 nodes, 2) enabled prefix/KV cache for high-traffic routes, 3) temporarily routed tenant-acme to dedicated pool. Error rates dropped ~85% by 12:10 PT.
Arjun: Thanks. Current status? Who's primary/secondary for the next shift?
Zoe: Current status: system stable but autoscaler still shows oscillation risk under burst patterns. No active pages now. Handing primary -> Arjun, secondary -> Marta. Note: APAC coverage gap 22:00–02:00 PT (no overlap) — we need a fallback shadow from platform team for that window.
Marta: I can cover secondary. I'll follow up with infra to add a scheduled scale policy to mitigate oscillation. I'll also draft a short CS note for affected tenants and post for review.
Zoe: Runbook / quick checks: 
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west/embeddings (p95, autoscaler graphs)
- Incidents board: https://incidents.redwood/INC-9876
- Quick CLI checks:
```
kubectl get hpa -n prod embeddings-euw
kubectl logs -l app=embeddings -n prod --tail=200
```
Arjun: I'll take primary. My immediate action items: 1) add scheduled scale policy for tomorrow's peak (09:00 PT), 2) request APAC shadow from platform (cc @Marta), 3) post proactive comm to customers by EOD and link to status page.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet: "If embedding p95 > 600ms and 429s > 500/5m: scale +2 nodes, enable fallback-model embed-fast-quant, and open coordination channel #incidents-embed." https://runbooks.redwood/embed-fallback
Marta: Noted. I'll open a ticket for the platform team and ping @platform-lead. Draft CS note will be in #customer-success for edits.
Zoe: One more operational note — we left the noisy reindex job disabled and queued. To re-enable (only after safe capacity is confirmed):
```
airflow unpause dag=batch-reindex && airflow backfill -s 2026-03-18 -e 2026-03-18 batch-reindex --max_active_runs=1
```
Zoe: Handing off now. Arjun primary, Marta secondary. Ping me on pager if anything escalates. :wave:
Arjun: Got it — I'll own this and keep eyes on autoscaler + customer comms. :thumbsup:
Marta: I'll be reachable on Slack + pager. Thanks Zoe — enjoy your break. :coffee:
